article_title: The AI Agent Security Gap — How AgentForge Closes It
image_prompt: Split-panel security comparison visualization for AI agent frameworks. Left side: three glowing red warning shields labeled 'OpenClaw', 'Hermes Agent', 'OpenHuman' with exposed vulnerability icons — cracked locks, leaking data streams, crossed-out sandbox icons, CVE text badges, OAuth token scatter. Center: large blue padlock splitting the two sides. Right side: 'AgentForge' green shield with capability-based security diagram — a WASM sandbox hexagon containing a skill module, four locked capability gates (filesystem, network, process, memory) with checkmark icons, static Go binary code streams, zero-trust architecture diagram, no external connections leaking. Dark navy/black background with holographic grid overlay. Cinematic volumetric lighting, dark blue and teal gradients, HUD-style annotation panels, clean typography. 16:9 landscape format.
style_notes: Designed for 16:9 landscape. The split-panel comparison format maps directly to the article's architecture. Dark cinematic aesthetic consistent with prior runs (Run #4 dashboard, Run #5 radial cluster).
